action.description:
Action is what to show: open-url (the notification has a link: open
URL with the system's default handler), show-run (it's about a run: its
routine's window, on that run) or show-app (about the app itself, e.g.
an update: the app).

url.description: URL, for open-url: an http or https link.

hook.description: Hook is true when Routine names a hook: show the hook's window.

title: procauto notifications open --json
description: ClickOutput is `notifications open --json`: what clicking a notification shows.
